mentions.name: Apptown
mentions.description: A self-hosted software forge and agent platform ('mini Heroku') that builds and maintains small apps and games. It runs on Mac or Linux in a temp container, is self-hostable, and can use local models. It deploys smallish things predictably and consistently with low friction, then helps maintain them long term, handling chores such as dependency and container updates.
mentions.problem: Deploying and maintaining small apps involves low-friction, predictable deployment plus ongoing chores like dependency and container updates; large-scale platforms aren't suited for this.
mentions.source_excerpt: A self hosted software forge / factory / agent platform / mini heroku thing. It's not polished yet but it's building and maintaining little apps and games. https://github.com/flokkit/apptown
mentions.author: xyzzy123
